scientific_integrity: A self-contained symbolic comparison proves the exact negative-type threshold on any existing finite generalized hexagon of equal order; exact symbolic checker corroborates the polynomial recurrence and sampled inequalities. Independent audit has not been conducted.

title: Quintic collapse of generalized roundness on finite generalized-hexagon incidence graphs
